name: SigNet-10
description: A signal-level network traffic dataset and CNN-based benchmark for classifying network flows/packets into 10 traffic classes.
reputation: Adopted within network-traffic and cybersecurity research as a signal-level classification benchmark, but not a widely established industry standard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; relatively small/controlled dataset with potential class imbalance and overfitting risk; signal-level captures may not generalize across different capture environments.
